subject: Approval request: liability ceiling adjustment & one-time credit for Corvax pilot
messages:
From: Amir Khan <amir.khan@corvax.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Rios <sofia.rios@corvax.io>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot SOW and commercial terms (redlines attached)

Diego — appreciate the draft. A couple of substantive asks from our counsel before we can sign: 1) raise the customer-friendly liability cap to $1,000,000 (we understand this is above your standard ceiling for pilots); 2) remove the broad warranty disclaimer around third-party model outputs and replace with a narrow warranty for service availability and security; 3) indemnity carveouts for data processed under the pilot (our lawyers insist).

I've attached our redlines (redlines_20261102.docx). Also, given the change in risk profile, we need a one-time implementation credit of $20,000 to offset validation and compliance work.

Can you escalate to your deal desk / legal? We can be flexible on timing if this is reviewed by your execs.

Thanks,
Amir
Amir Khan
Head of Platform Partnerships, Corvax Therapeutics
Attachment: redlines_20261102.docx (docx, 45KB)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot SOW and commercial terms (redlines attached) — corvax pilot needs exec consideration

Forwarding Corvax redlines; they asked for: 1) liability cap increase to $1M for the pilot; 2) changes to warranty language to limit disclaimers; 3) indemnity carveouts for data; and 4) one-time $20k implementation credit.

Quick context: Corvax is a mid-stage biotech, will run a 6-week pilot with sensitive PHI-like datasets (pseudonymized). They are a strategic reference target in pharma. Pipeline is healthy but this is our standard hosted product with some custom onboarding work.

Requesting: legal read + recommendation, and commercial approval path (I expect this needs senior sign-off). If possible please respond with: a) recommended cap (and whether time-limited to pilot), b) if indemnity carveouts are acceptable, c) whether to offer the $20k credit (and if so, whether to convert to prepay/commit).

Attachments forwarded: redlines_20261102.docx, Corvax_SOW_v2.pdf

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Corvax_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf, 220KB)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot SOW and commercial terms (redlines attached) — initial legal review

Diego / team — reviewed Corvax redlines. Summary:
- Liability cap: standard pilot cap is $250k. Raising to $1M is material. Acceptable only if scoped to the pilot duration (6 weeks) and limited to direct damages with a contractual carve-out for consequential damages still in place. Recommend an explicit temporal limitation and a phase-out clause after pilot converts to paid commitment.
- Indemnity: their requested carveouts for data-processing are broad. Propose a narrow data-processing indemnity limited to gross negligence or willful misconduct tied to our handling of customer-supplied datasets; include mutual indemnity for third-party IP claims.
- Warranty: rather than removing warranty disclaimers, offer a limited uptime/SLA commitment for the pilot (e.g., 99.5% availability during business hours) and a schedule of remediation credits. Avoid a warranty that guarantees model outputs.

Risk/controls: require a short security assessment and that Corvax signs an addendum limiting the use-case for PHI-like inputs. Also recommend that the pricing credit be milestone-tied (e.g., $10k on SOW execution, $10k on pilot completion if they provide required security attestation).

My recommendation: escalate to commercial leadership for exec approval of a time-limited cap increase to $1M, conditional indemnity narrowing, and a structured credit. If leadership approves, legal will draft targeted redlines and a pilot addendum.

-Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Lead Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: legal_summary_20261102.txt (txt, 3KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot SOW and commercial terms (redlines attached) — commercial perspective

Team — commercial view: Corvax is a high-value reference in therapeutics; conversion probability 60%+ after pilot. We should be willing to make limited concessions to secure the program. Proposed deal desk recommendation:
- Approve temporary liability cap of $750,000 for the pilot (compromise between standard and their ask), explicitly limited to direct damages and to the 6-week pilot window.
- Accept Jasmine's indemnity and warranty language changes as redlines (narrowed indemnity; SLA for availability).
- Offer a one-time credit of $15,000 (not $20k) split: $7.5k on SOW signing, $7.5k on successful pilot completion and delivery of their security attestation.

If leadership wants to meet their $20k ask, we ask for a 6-month commitment or a larger annual contract.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T17:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: liability ceiling adjustment & one-time credit for Corvax pilot — leadership decision

Team — after reviewing the commercial and legal recommendations, I approve the following limited exception for Corvax: 
1) Liability cap: increase to $750,000 for the pilot only (6-week period). Cap applies to direct damages only; consequential damages remain excluded. This exception is strictly pilot-scoped and expires upon pilot end unless we execute a paid conversion with negotiated terms.
2) Indemnity & warranty: accept the narrowed indemnity language (Jasmine to finalize) and provide a targeted uptime commitment for the pilot (99.5% business-hours availability) with remediation credits.
3) Credit: one-time implementation credit of $15,000 split across milestones as Ben proposed.

Conditions: Jasmine to produce final redlines and a pilot addendum; Diego to obtain Corvax security attestation prior to onboarding. Any deviation from these terms requires my sign-off and will be escalated to the CFO.

Approved by,
Laura Bennett
VP, Commercial Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachment: approval_record_20261103.pdf (pdf, 12KB)
